summary: Silvercorp Metals filed a Form 6-K (the US equivalent of a Canadian continuous-disclosure report) containing only a Report of Voting Results from its annual general and special meeting held October 2, 2026. All management-nominated directors were elected, with Dr. Rui Feng receiving 98.86% support and Paul Simpson the lowest at 83.76% for. Shareholders approved Deloitte LLP as auditors (99.67%), amended articles (95.74% for), and an amended share-based compensation plan (84.51% for). No special situation, transaction, or board-level event is disclosed; a routine meeting outcome with no deal terms, advisors, or risk-arb angle.
